title: Ventilation Grid
summary: A narrow corridor of exposed ducts and rusted grates leads to a junction of ventilation shafts. A single access panel and a flickering emergency light dominate the space.
arrival_narration: You step into a low-ceilinged corridor where the air hums with the distant whir of fans. The walls are lined with corroded metal ducts, their grates warped by age. A single access panel—marked with a faded ‘C’—hangs slightly ajar on the right wall. Above it, an emergency light flickers weakly, casting long shadows. The floor slopes downward toward a junction of three ventilation shafts ahead.

spatial_anomalies: one duct panel emits a faint hissing sound
